name: anti-bot-waf-bypass
title: Bypass anti-bot WAF (Akamai) for blocked retailers
description: Farmers and similar retailers behind Akamai Bot Manager serve a WAF deny page to headless Chromium, so no price reaches the model. Investigate stealth/proxy/browser-fingerprint approaches to fetch the real product page.
creator: Howard Ju
notes: SPIKE VERDICT B (detection-only) — reconfirmed 2026-08-04 retry. Round1: stealth gets behavioral challenge then /WAF_Deny_Page/ ~15s. Round2 retry (user asked make Farmers work): NZ context, homepage warm-up, system Chrome channel, headed Chrome, Firefox, mobile UA, long waits, mouse, persistent profile, in-site clicks, search, Intershop API probes, undici IP probe — ALL fail on PDP. Key finding: homepage soft-passes (~430KB real HTML + prices) so IP is not total-ban; product/category/search/Intershop paths hard-block (WAF deny or Access Denied). No free local bypass. Stealth NOT wired into fetch-page. Detection expanded: akamai-waf + akamai-access-denied + akamai-behavioral-challenge. Next escalation still residential proxy (user-deferred). Evidence: verdict.md.
